_contract: WHAT THE MAINTAINER DECIDED, and only that. Every other field of the authorization -- identities, stages, plan hash, contract hash, seeds, probe count, battery, harness, ceiling -- is DERIVED by d2_screening_authorization.build_payload from the tree it binds, and this grant is REFUSED if it states one (GRANT_MAY_NOT_STATE).
_one_use: ONE issuance, ONE launcher session per authorization. A replacement after a pre-science engineering failure is a NEW one-use authorization netted against this cumulative envelope; it is issued only while the envelope's remainder holds a full session's hard ceiling plus the teardown reserve, and never over an earlier attempt whose cost is not booked or whose teardown is not verified (AGENTS.md P12.1).
granted_by: maintainer, 2026-10-15 UTC: D2 Behavioural Screening Final Independent Review and Conditional Grant (independent review of 8e8ae849). Conditional approval of a $25.00 cumulative all-in grant, to be issued only after the three $0 repairs (ranking evidence gate, durable training records, cumulative retry reserve), their tests, commit, push and the executable-commit rebinding.

any change to K, the seeds, the SESOI, the selection rule or the battery
